Practised plotting points from ordered pairs and identifying quadrants from coordinate signs.

end.parentNote: Harsh practised reading ordered pairs, quadrant signs, axis points, reflections, and the origin. They used the method of checking x first and y second, and explained that changing only x reflects a point across the y-axis. There was one mix-up between (3, 2) and (2, 3), which was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, ask Harsh to plot a few points and say the x-coordinate before the y-coordinate each time.
